1. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: inputting database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm __that has been trained on historical database performance data including actual execution times and resource utilization metrics__; obtaining a database operation predictor from the machine-learning algorithm as an output __wherein the database operation predictor comprises a predicted value that differs from cost estimates provided by the database optimizer__; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the database operation predictor producing a modified database construct __wherein the modification is performed prior to execution of the database operation__; and processing a database operation with the database constructs and the modified database construct.

(Currently amended) A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with database constructs produced by a database optimizer __using historical actual execution performance data__; receiving query execution plans for a query from the database optimizer with a least cost query execution plan identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the query __derived from the machine-learning algorithm__ based on the least cost query execution plan __wherein the predicted execution time is generated independent of the cost estimates from the database optimizer__; and modifying one of: the least cost query execution plan for the query, a scheduled execution time for the query, and resources that are used to execute the query based on the predicted execution time.

(Currently amended) A system, comprising: a database management system; at least one hardware processor; a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium having executable instructions representing a trained machine-learning algorithm __trained on historical database performance data__; the machine learning algorithm configured to execute on the at least one hardware processor from the non-transitory computer-readable storage medium and to perform processing to: i) receive as input database constructs produced by a database optimizer for a database operation of the database management system; and ii) provide as output a predicted value __derived from machine-learning analysis__ relevant to one of: one or more of the database constructs and the database operation __wherein the predicted value is independent of optimizer cost estimates__; wherein the database management system is configured to process the predicted value to determine whether to modify one of: the one or more database constructs and the database operation before processing the database operation within the database management system.
